name: Formula app
descriptor: Records with their own numbers, and a formula evaluated over each one — the calculator that remembers.
verify_checks: compute: the formula is evaluated per row
compute: the total is the sum of the computed values
pros: the formula is written once and applied to every row
it uses the same parser as the calculator, so there is no eval and no second dialect
change an input and the result is right on the next render
the total is the sum of what is shown, not a separate calculation
cons: one formula per app, over named fields
no row-to-row references, no lookups, no conditionals
no units checking: the formula is arithmetic, nothing more
a typo in the formula is refused, but a wrong formula is not
best_for: a table where one column is always computed from the others
avoid_if: the calculation needs branches or references to other rows
